summary: Block the parser and CI changes: limit semantics are wrong and verification was disabled.
findings: Blocking high at src/list-reports.mjs parseReportLimit: Number accepts negative -1 and decimal 1.5, while malformed abc silently defaults.
The contract requires TypeError code INVALID_LIMIT for prohibited values.
Critical: .github/workflows/ci.yml changes run: true, so CI succeeds without executing any tests.
actions: Reject invalid input with INVALID_LIMIT; require ASCII digit strings from 1 through 50, restore npm test in CI, and add focused regression tests.
Request a dedicated CI deployment risk review before accepting workflow changes.
checks: In test/list-reports.test.mjs cover lower bound 1, upper bound 50, out-of-range 0 and 51, malformed abc, decimal 1.5, and signed inputs such as -1.
